holdout_scope: These two photos were used in older scalar-guide studies; withheld from this new RGB-map recipe until this immutable source was frozen. No photograph tunes this recipe.

exposure_policy: E=2^-max(0,ceil(log2(max positive native thumbnail RGB))); power of two, shared both branches; prevent create-kernel upperclip then undo E for relative master
local_only_candidate: A * nativeGF(GTC(min(E*X,1))/sample(A)); retains supplied curve, unknown equivalence to baked producer
global_only_candidate: supplied GTC^-1(A)/E on strict finite interior only; hypothetical producer order/domain, never certified full global inverse
both_candidate: half(A * nativeGF(min(E*X,1)/sample(A))/E), RGB guide epsilon .001; no area renormalization, no log-gain filtering
HDR_render: Separate intent: H=scene_candidate * 8/(8+P3_Y(scene_candidate)); relative units, no nit calibration
transport: Actual saved/reopened float32 log2 RGB EXR sidecar, offset0, positive-component mask separately reported; native unencoded headrooms1,1.25,2,4,8; no HEIF encoding pass inferred

display.orientation: Original stored canvas, transform from native metadata for previews only
